title: Cumulative React/TypeScript and local API project
description: Compile the interface, operate a real scoped HTTP API, inject stream failures and defend identity, parsing and recovery boundaries.

sections.title: Clean start
sections.text: Download and extract the complete project ZIP. Read projects/evidence-workbench/README.md. From that folder run npm ci --ignore-scripts, npm run build and python3 server.py. Open the loopback URL. Node 22.12+ and Python 3.11+ are required; browser acceptance checks use the repository development dependencies.

sections.title: Independent acceptance
sections.text: Implement from a blank component, then demonstrate normal completion, unsupported-question abstention, a malformed event, disconnect before completion, cancellation and an identity switch during a slow answer. Inspect network bytes for other-owner data. Record a regression that fails when generation ownership is removed.

sections.title: Deployment and recovery extension
sections.text: The README includes a non-root container, a two-replica Kubernetes manifest, failure injection with an unavailable image and explicit rollout undo. Use a disposable local cluster. Cluster execution is a learner acceptance activity until actual output is recorded; it is not inferred from a valid manifest.

title: Independent technical and accessibility review packet
description: Use changed-assumption interview defenses, multilingual and permission slices, claim/source adjudication and manual interaction tasks.

sections.title: Evidence before a grade
sections.text: Record artifact and source identities, commands and observed outcomes. Separate deterministic assertions, semantic judgments and manual accessibility results. A pending check remains pending. The packet does not grant an independent approval.

sections.title: Meaningful failure slices
sections.text: Evaluate supported and unsupported answers, cross-owner access, Arabic and mixed-direction text, Unicode normalization, policy revisions, injection and stream interruption separately. The current English keyword fixture cannot establish multilingual retrieval quality; build that extension and obtain fluent review.

sections.title: Interview and release defense
sections.text: Ask the learner to reproduce an unfamiliar failure and defend a changed assumption: committed remote effects, correlated evaluation rows, retained deleted data or an upgraded protocol. Reject critical disclosure under the declared gate even when mean quality improves.
